text: A search snippet's date can be sidebar text: an arkieva.com post read 'November 3rd, 2026' in search but the page JSON-LD datePublished said 2026-08-11 — out of window. Read the page's own datePublished/dateModified (curl + grep JSON-LD) before writing any blog row's Date cell; the seeder trusts the typed date.

Pricing an accuracy point: an ideas.repec.org record's own URL carries the volume/pages digits, so a row led on '454' self-verifies on the 'Printed from' line — never lead a row on a citation page number; pick a figure the abstract body owns or use a different source. Verified instead: demand-planning.com's M5-value simulation (80/12.6/7.3) is digit-rich and fetches clean.
